review: 122.1g-1: trigger_pending left the Siege trigger's 'you may cast it transformed' choice open and did not say the trigger exiles the battle; fixed the decision (A declines) and stated the exile outcome.

122.1i-1: library put Forest on top, so two rad counters would mill Forest and one Grizzly Bears, contradicting both firing variants' expected outcomes; reordered the library to put both Grizzly Bears on top.

scenarios.title: +X/+Y and -X/-Y counters change power and toughness
decisions: No action is taken; the stable board is read.

variants.label: plus_counters
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has two +1/+1 counters and is a 4/4.

variants.label: charge_counters
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has two charge counters instead of +1/+1 counters.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is a 2/2; charge counters change no characteristic.

variants.label: minus_counter
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has one -1/-1 counter instead of two +1/+1 counters.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is a 1/1.

scenarios.title: A keyword counter gives the permanent that keyword
decisions: No action is taken; the stable board is read.

variants.label: flying_counter
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has flying and is a 2/2.

variants.label: charge_counter
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has one charge counter instead of a flying counter.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has no flying and is a 2/2.

variants.label: deathtouch_counter
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has one deathtouch counter instead of a flying counter.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has deathtouch and does not have flying.

scenarios.title: A shield counter prevents damage and is removed instead
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves.

variants.label: shield_damage
variants.expected: The 2 damage to Grizzly Bears is prevented and its shield counter is removed; Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield with no damage marked and no counters.

variants.label: no_shield
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has no shield counter.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is dealt 2 damage and moves to B's graveyard in the state-based check.

variants.label: shrunk_not_damaged
variants.delta: A casts Disfigure targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Swamp, instead of Shock.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears becomes 0/0 and moves to B's graveyard in the state-based check; its shield counter did not apply.

scenarios.title: A shield counter replaces destruction by an effect with removing the counter
decisions: A casts Doom Blade targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping two Swamps.
Both players pass; Doom Blade resolves.

variants.label: shield_destroy
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is not destroyed; its shield counter is removed and it stays on the battlefield with no counters.

variants.label: no_shield
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has no shield counter.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: shrunk_not_destroyed
variants.delta: A casts Disfigure targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping one Swamp, instead of Doom Blade.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears becomes 0/0 and moves to B's graveyard in the state-based check; its shield counter is not used because nothing destroyed it.

scenarios.title: A stun counter replaces untapping with removing the counter
decisions: A casts Vitalize, tapping Forest.
Both players pass; Vitalize resolves.

variants.label: one_stun
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears does not untap; its stun counter is removed and it stays tapped with no counters.

variants.label: no_stun
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has no stun counter.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears untaps.

variants.label: two_stun
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has two stun counters.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears stays tapped and keeps one stun counter.

scenarios.title: A planeswalker with 0 loyalty counters is put into the graveyard

setup.notes: Jace Beleren has been on the battlefield since an earlier turn; no loyalty ability has been activated this turn.

decisions: B activates Jace Beleren's -1 ability targeting B, removing one loyalty counter as the cost.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: one_loyalty
variants.expected: Jace Beleren has 0 loyalty after paying the cost and is put into B's graveyard in the state-based check before the ability resolves; the ability still resolves and B draws a card.

variants.label: two_loyalty
variants.delta: Jace Beleren has 2 loyalty.
variants.expected: Jace Beleren has 1 loyalty and stays on the battlefield; B draws a card.

scenarios.title: Ten poison counters lose the game

setup.notes: B has 9 poison counters. B controls no creatures.

decisions: A declares Plague Stinger as an attacker against B.
No blockers are declared.
Combat damage is dealt: Plague Stinger deals 1 damage with infect.

variants.label: nine_poison
variants.expected: B receives 1 poison counter instead of losing life, now has 10 poison counters and loses the game in the state-based check. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: eight_poison
variants.delta: B has 8 poison counters.
variants.expected: B receives 1 poison counter, now has 9, and stays in the game. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: no_infect
variants.delta: A attacks with Grizzly Bears instead of Plague Stinger.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to B: B's life is 18, B still has 9 poison counters and stays in the game.

scenarios.title: A battle with 0 defense counters goes to the graveyard unless it is the source of a pending trigger

setup.notes: B is the protector of A's Invasion of Zendikar.

decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Invasion of Zendikar, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Lightning Bolt resolves and removes the last 3 defense counters; the Siege's defeat trigger goes on the stack.
A casts Stifle targeting the defeat trigger, tapping Island.
Both players pass; Stifle resolves.

variants.label: stifled
variants.expected: The defeat trigger is countered. Invasion of Zendikar has 0 defense and is not the source of an ability on the stack, so it is put into A's graveyard.

variants.label: trigger_pending
variants.delta: A does not cast Stifle; both players pass, the defeat trigger resolves, and A chooses not to cast Invasion of Zendikar transformed.
variants.expected: While the defeat trigger is on the stack, Invasion of Zendikar stays on the battlefield with 0 defense and is not put into the graveyard. The trigger resolves and exiles it; it stays in A's exile and A's graveyard is empty.

variants.label: four_defense
variants.delta: Invasion of Zendikar has 4 defense counters, so no defeat trigger goes on the stack and Stifle is not cast.
variants.expected: Invasion of Zendikar keeps 1 defense counter and stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Damage to a battle removes defense counters (310.6). Forge may implement the Siege's intrinsic defeat trigger engine-side rather than in the card script.

scenarios.title: A permanent with a finality counter is exiled instead of going to the graveyard
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves.

variants.label: finality_dies
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is dealt lethal damage and is exiled instead of moving to B's graveyard; B's graveyard is empty.

variants.label: no_finality
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has no finality counter.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: bounced
variants.delta: A casts Unsummon targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Island, instead of Shock.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears returns to B's hand; it does not go to the graveyard, so nothing is exiled.

scenarios.title: Rad counters trigger a mill at the start of the precombat main phase

setup.notes: A has 2 rad counters. A's draw for the turn has already been made; the top of A's library is listed first. B has no rad counters.

decisions: Both players pass priority in the draw step.
The precombat main phase begins and the rad trigger, if any, goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: two_rad
variants.expected: The rad trigger fires: A mills 2 cards (both Grizzly Bears), loses 2 life (18) and loses 2 rad counters, leaving 0.

variants.label: no_rad
variants.delta: A has no rad counters.
variants.expected: No rad trigger fires; nothing is milled and A's life stays 20.

variants.label: one_rad
variants.delta: A has 1 rad counter.
variants.expected: The rad trigger fires: A mills 1 card (a Grizzly Bears), loses 1 life (19) and has 0 rad counters.

scenarios.forge_notes: Rad counters on a player are not a card state, so they are given in notes.

scenarios.title: Hone counters on an Equipment give +1/+0 to the equipped creature
decisions: No action is taken; the stable board is read.

variants.label: two_hone
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is a 4/2.

variants.label: no_hone
variants.delta: Sting has no hone counters.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is a 2/2.

variants.label: unattached

scenarios.title: Counters cease to exist when an object changes zones
decisions: A casts Cloudshift targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Plains.
Both players pass; Cloudshift resolves.

variants.label: exile_return
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is exiled and returns to the battlefield as a new object with no counters, a 2/2.

variants.label: phase_out
variants.delta: A casts Reality Ripple targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping two Islands, instead of Cloudshift.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears phases out without changing zones and keeps its two +1/+1 counters.

scenarios.title: +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on one permanent cancel in pairs
decisions: A activates Fume Spitter's ability, sacrificing it, targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and puts a -1/-1 counter on Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: one_each
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has one +1/+1 and one -1/-1 counter; both are removed in the state-based check, leaving no counters and a 2/2.

variants.label: only_minus
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has no +1/+1 counter.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears keeps its one -1/-1 counter and is a 1/1.

variants.label: two_plus
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has two +1/+1 counters.
variants.expected: One +1/+1 and the -1/-1 counter are removed, leaving one +1/+1 counter; Grizzly Bears is a 3/3.

scenarios.title: Counters above a stated maximum are removed

setup.notes: Rasputin Dreamweaver started the turn untapped.

decisions: Rasputin Dreamweaver's upkeep trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves and puts a dream counter on Rasputin Dreamweaver.

variants.label: at_cap
variants.expected: Rasputin Dreamweaver ends with 7 dream counters; the counter above the maximum of seven is removed.

variants.label: below_cap
variants.delta: Rasputin Dreamweaver has 5 dream counters.
variants.expected: Rasputin Dreamweaver ends with 6 dream counters; nothing is removed.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge scripts the cap as a MaxCounter static, which may refuse the eighth counter rather than remove it in a state-based check; the end count (7) is the same either way.

scenarios.title: Moving a counter removes it from one object and puts it on another, or does nothing
decisions: A casts Fate Transfer targeting Grizzly Bears (source) and Runeclaw Bear, tapping two Islands.
Both players pass; Fate Transfer resolves.

variants.label: counters_move
variants.expected: Both +1/+1 counters leave Grizzly Bears (now 2/2) and are put on Runeclaw Bear (now 4/4).

variants.label: no_counters
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears has no counters.
variants.expected: No counter is removed or put on anything; both creatures stay 2/2.

variants.label: target_leaves
variants.delta: In response to Fate Transfer, A casts Unsummon targeting Runeclaw Bear, tapping the third Island; both players pass and Unsummon resolves first.
variants.expected: Runeclaw Bear returns to A's hand; no counter moves, and Grizzly Bears keeps its two +1/+1 counters (a 4/4).

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's MoveCounter effect may handle a missing second target differently from the rule; the expected outcome is that nothing moves.

scenarios.title: The controller puts the counters on an object entering with counters
decisions: A casts Hangarback Walker with X=2, tapping four Forests.
Both players pass; Hangarback Walker resolves and enters with its counters.

variants.label: own_vorinclex
variants.expected: A is the player putting the counters, so Vorinclex doubles them: Hangarback Walker enters with 4 +1/+1 counters and is a 4/4.

variants.label: opponent_vorinclex
variants.delta: Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider is on B's battlefield instead of A's.
variants.expected: A is an opponent of Vorinclex's controller, so the counters are halved: Hangarback Walker enters with 1 +1/+1 counter and is a 1/1.

variants.label: no_vorinclex
variants.delta: Neither player controls Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider.
variants.expected: Hangarback Walker enters with 2 +1/+1 counters and is a 2/2.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's Vorinclex replacement keys on the source of the AddCounter event; whether an etbCounter replacement names the entering permanent's controller as the source is the point being tested.

scenarios.title: An Nth-counter trigger fires only when the count crosses from below N

setup.notes: The turn is in its first main phase, so Midnight Clock's upkeep trigger is not involved.

decisions: A activates Midnight Clock's {2}{U} ability, tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; the ability resolves and puts an hour counter on Midnight Clock.

variants.label: eleven_to_twelve
variants.expected: Midnight Clock goes from 11 to 12 hour counters and its trigger fires: A's hand and graveyard are shuffled into the library, A draws seven cards, and Midnight Clock is exiled; A's graveyard is empty.

variants.label: ten_to_eleven
variants.delta: Midnight Clock has 10 hour counters.
variants.expected: Midnight Clock goes from 10 to 11 hour counters; its trigger does not fire and Grizzly Bears stays in A's graveyard.

variants.label: twelve_to_thirteen
variants.delta: Midnight Clock already has 12 hour counters.
variants.expected: Midnight Clock goes from 12 to 13 hour counters; it already had 12 or more beforehand, so its trigger does not fire and it stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: The twelve-counter start in the last variant is reachable if the twelfth-counter trigger was countered earlier. Forge scripts the trigger as CounterAmount$ EQ12 on the counter total.

scenarios.title: A leaves-the-battlefield trigger gives the other object the same counters the leaver had
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Iron Apprentice, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves and Iron Apprentice dies.
Iron Apprentice's trigger targets Grizzly Bears; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: two_counters
variants.expected: Iron Apprentice moves to A's graveyard; Grizzly Bears receives two +1/+1 counters (the number the Apprentice had) and is a 4/4.

variants.label: two_kinds
variants.delta: Iron Apprentice has one +1/+1 counter and one charge counter.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears receives one +1/+1 counter and one charge counter and is a 3/3.

variants.label: bounced
variants.delta: A casts Unsummon targeting Iron Apprentice, tapping Island, instead of Shock.
variants.expected: Iron Apprentice returns to A's hand; it did not die, so its trigger does not fire and Grizzly Bears stays a 2/2.

scenarios.title: An ability with a sacrifice cost gives the other object the same counters the sacrificed object had
decisions: A activates Zack Fair's ability, paying {1} with a Plains and sacrificing Zack Fair, targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: two_counters
variants.expected: Zack Fair moves to A's graveyard; Grizzly Bears gains indestructible until end of turn and receives two +1/+1 counters (the number Zack Fair had), making it a 4/4.

variants.label: one_counter
variants.delta: Zack Fair has one +1/+1 counter.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears receives one +1/+1 counter and is a 3/3.

variants.label: no_counters
variants.delta: Zack Fair has no counters.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears gains indestructible until end of turn and receives no counters; it stays a 2/2.

scenarios.forge_notes: Zack Fair normally enters with a +1/+1 counter; the setup gives it two counters directly.
